description: An ordered, growable collection backed by an array, with cheap index access and appends but linear-time searches.
A hash-based map from unique, non-null keys to values whose enumeration order is undefined.
A collection of unique values with fast membership checks, where `Add` returns `false` for a value already present.
An `IEqualityComparer<T>` such as `StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase` that decides when two keys are the same, passed to the dictionary or set constructor.
A wrapper such as `ReadOnlyCollection<T>` that stops its holder from changing the collection while the owner can still change it underneath.
A collection from `System.Collections.Immutable` that never changes after creation, where every modifying method returns a new instance.
A `FrozenDictionary<TKey,TValue>` or `FrozenSet<T>` that is costly to build but optimized for reads, meant for data created once at startup.
